outside.waitsOn: case-carriage: the item in its interface files
tests: R25, R5, R2: document-copy stands after file-reputation and before R26's question-explore (T41), answering under doccopy; given its now alone, never daily nor always due; without case-carriage it is absent
R25, R1, R2: due, it calls exactly copyBatch({}) once, awaited, its answer under doccopy as given; nothing names a member or a file; not due, it is absent and copyBatch is not called

R25, R1, R15: its due and wake are both copyWake(now): due within the grace of that instant, the alarm at it when it is the earliest, none when it is null; an answer that is not an instant in ms is none
R25, R7, R11, R18: copyWake is asked afresh at every firing, arm and start, each with its now; a wake case-carriage moves is followed at once; nothing but the alarm is ever written or read for it

R25, R3: a refusal case-carriage answers (DOCUMENT_COPY_NO_STORE) is the tick's answer; a copyWake or copyBatch that throws is answered {error} under doccopy, every other consumer still ticks and the reconcile runs

R25, R9, R17: it registers once with case-carriage's onCopyWork, as scheduler; each call arms the alarm at once at copyWake's instant, never pushes it later, runs no batch and writes nothing but the alarm
R25, R1: an onCopyWork call made inside a firing arms nothing of its own: the firing's reconcile stands
R25, R23: a refused onCopyWork registration (LISTENER_DECLARED, LISTENER_MALFORMED) is a start-up fault in faults(), never ignored; the consumer still runs
R25: schedulerOf builds the consumer over the host's one case-carriage and registers its notice at start, once

R25, R9: against the real case-carriage, a member document queued on an idle instance arms the alarm at once through onCopyWork; the firing copies it through copyBatch; then nothing is queued, so no alarm is held

R25, R7, R11: against the real case-carriage, a failed read of the evidence store leaves the document queued and the alarm at its retry instant, case-carriage's own, never at once; a restarted scheduler re-derives that instant from case-carriage's tables, and the retry copies it
R25, R15: against the real case-carriage with no evidence store bound, copyWake answers null, so document-copy is not due, wants no wake and nothing is derived; bound again, the same firing copies it

outside.waitsOn: duties: the item in its interface files
tests: R5, R21: the six stand after working-on-attest, in R21's order, follow before duty-transitions; R2: each answers under its own key
R21, R2: each consumer calls exactly its owner's services, its answer under its key; a consumer that did not tick is absent
R21, R10: follow is batch-bounded and receives the rank with its now; the other five are given their now alone
R21: answers' and inquiry's services read now as instant text, and their wakes are read back as instants; one due now wants now
R21 (K1522): a daily consumer is due at the group's local day start, runs once that day, and wakes at the next local day's start
R21: with no time zone held the day read is the UTC day, and the answer says so (zone null)
R21 (K1566): while a pass is under way it is due at every firing, its owner's cursor handed back, until the owner answers none
R21, R15: a daily consumer whose pass found nothing to work over wants no wake, so an idle instance holds no timer; the next start asks again
R21, R3: a daily pass that throws, or that its owner refuses, is answered under its key and counts the day as run, so the alarm never spins
R21, R18: the daily consumers' state is the storage value sched_daily, never a table: a restarted instance does not run a pass twice in a day
R21, R17: arm runs no daily pass and writes nothing but the alarm
R9: a dated wait set, told inside the promotion's transaction, arms the alarm at the dated waits' wake once that transaction has returned, once
R9: a follow recorded, ended or re-dated arms the alarm at the follow's wake through following's onFollowed (its R19); arming only schedules
R21: against the real duties, the alarm records each tracked occurrence's state change as of the firing, once that local day, and only what moved the next
R21, R9: against the real inquiry, a promotion setting a dated wait arms the alarm at its local day's start, and that alarm marks it once
R21, R9, R10: against the real following, a register followed arms the alarm through its onFollowed (R19); the alarm reads it once, given the rank, and wakes a day after the read
